title: test_channel.py: misleading comment about channel vs tdma formula
description:
## Location
python/tests/link/test_channel.py:179-180

## Bug
Comment incorrectly states:
```python
# tdma.py uses max(num_channels, 3) while channel.py uses max(n_channels - 1, 1)
```

Both `synchronized_hop_channel` implementations use `max(n_channels, 3)`. The `max(n_channels - 1, 1)` formula is in `select_channel`'s hash-based path, not `synchronized_hop_channel`.

## Impact
Could mislead maintainers into incorrect changes or confusion about implementation parity.

## Fix
Correct or remove the misleading comment. The implementations are identical for positive 32-bit seeds.
